description: Call a read-only window.app.local method: isInLoader, getDeviceById, or sendGetMessage with a read-only B0 command (DEVICE_STATUS, GET_DEVICE_CONFIG, GET_BOARD_INFO, GET_BOARD_TYPE, GET_DEVICE_WIFI_MAC, SYSTEM_VERSION, MPY_PROJECT_INFO, MPY_CHECKSUM_INFO). Any other method or command is refused.
